posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked:
Dear IITM Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

I have opted for re-OPPE of the SC course this term and would like to clarify a few points regarding the virtual machine setup.

Could you please let me know when I can expect to receive the SSH key for my VM? Additionally, I would like to confirm whether the process of creating and configuring the VM for BPTs and OPPEs remains the same as in the previous term.

Lastly, please advise whether I need to generate a new SSH key for BPTs and OPPEs this term, or if I can continue using the SSH key from the previous term.

Thank you for your time and support.

Kind regards,

Ishaan Sawant ( roll no - 24f2007256)

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Hi Ishaan,

ishanite:

Could you please let me know when I can expect to receive the SSH key for my VM?

You already have access to it. Access is provide to all the students when the term starts.

ishanite:

Additionally, I would like to confirm whether the process of creating and configuring the VM for BPTs and OPPEs remains the same as in the previous term.

Yes, the process is exactly the same.

ishanite:

Lastly, please advise whether I need to generate a new SSH key for BPTs and OPPEs this term, or if I can continue using the SSH key from the previous term.

You will be able to use your existing key unless you created a new one. If you are not able to access VM then generate a new pair.

I hope I have answered your queries.

Do remember to submit (synchro eval) the BPTs (for this term) on time to be eligible for OPPE.

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain

posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked:
21f3000759:

You will be able to use your existing key unless you created a new one. If you are not able to access VM then generate a new pair.

I currently still have access to my old SSH key that I used for submitting previous BPTs. I would like to confirm whether I can continue using the same SSH key to submit my BPTs for this term as well. Will submissions made using this key be accepted and evaluated for the current term, or do I need to generate and register a new SSH key?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
You have only one VM account: your_roll_no@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in. The SSH key is not your account. It is just a way to log into that account.

Think of the VM account as your home, and the SSH key as the house key. You can change your lock & keys, but the house (your VM account) remains the same.

If your old key is still registered with your VM account, you can continue using it.

ishanite:

Will submissions made using this key be accepted and evaluated for the current term, or do I need to generate and register a new SSH key?

Yes, you can use existing keys since user account is the same. You don’t have to re-register it again. Remember to do synchro eval once the BPT submission starts & before the deadline.

posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked: thank you so much for your guidance

posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked:
Hello,
As per your guidance I opened my same (the same I used for last term SC VM) ssh key which is ssh 24f2007256@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in
and when I did ls/opt/se2001 I even got the lastest release BPT1 from problem 1-4

image1600×213 155 KB

but when I tried to create a new directory as mkdir bpt1 inside se2001 for solving question
I realised I already have all the bpts there

image1600×343 200 KB

and when I did synchro init and synchro eval it was already solved

image705×445 217 KB

so what to do in this scenario ??

Please guide me
